target_meaning: PCI (0-100 overall condition), DMI (Distress Manifestation Index), IRI (International Roughness Index), Pave_Type (Pavement material type e.g., Asphalt Concrete).
limitations: Since Indian sources are not publicly available as CSV, this Ontario dataset acts as the fallback. It provides genuine physical distress indices and material types, enabling mathematically sound and non-leaky prediction tasks. Note: 'SectionID ' is entirely blank because Ontario transitioned away from static LHRS references in favor of dynamic continuous distances post-2018. Overlapping and duplicate spatial intervals are legitimate distinct lane measurements (express/collector/passing).
